name: Horse Lord of the Plain (Mã Chủ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: One Thread of Wind (Nhất Tuyến Phong)
bonuses.rule: each time you and your companion strike the same target within 1 s, both of you heal 2 % of your health and you gain one Wind buff stack; at 5 stacks your next lance hit knocks the target down for 1 s. Your companion's hits on a target bearing any of your statuses deal 15 % more.

story: The founder's lance, the foal's bridle ring and the armour of thirty-one races. Khấu Mục Vân holds all three; the Packmate Collar is Đạp Vân's to wear, not his, and the set's last line does its work.

name: The Last of Phù Dao (Phù Dao Di Vật)

bonuses.rule: each blow you evade winds the whirlwind tighter, one Wind buff stack; when you cast a Wind escape or footwork art with 8 or more stacks you spend them all on a gust: for 2 s the foe's hits on you deal 20 % less, and you gain 2.5 % evasion for 4 s for each stack spent.

story: The abbey's pennant and habit, and her father's stone. Thôi Dương Giác holds all three, and means to hand the first two to whoever lights the abbey after her.
